name: Y. Lim
evidence: Full name resolved from the paper before searching: arXiv:2606.09178v1 prints 'Yongtaek Lim* - AI Safety Team, DATUMO.INC, Seoul, South Korea' (* equal contribution with Hyeji Choi). Identity corroborated independently: he also appears as 'YongTaek Lim, DATUMO INC.' in arXiv:2604.18976 (STAR-Teaming), arXiv:2602.20170 (CAGE culturally adaptive red-teaming) and arXiv:2606.19887 (FinRED) - same AI Safety Team, same red-teaming line of work. No email printed for him in any of those author blocks (only the corresponding author Minwoo Kim's mwkim@selectstar.ai), so email = not found; a selectstar.ai pattern address would be a templated guess and was not used. Searched site:linkedin.com/in "Yongtaek Lim" Datumo OR Selectstar and a broader 'Yongtaek Lim' Datumo/Selectstar/AI Safety Korea query: the broad query confirmed his DATUMO affiliation only through his papers and Selectstar company news, while the LinkedIn query returned no Yongtaek Lim profile at all (only unrelated Selectstar/SelectStar Solutions staff and unrelated Lims). No ResearchGate profile surfaced. Nothing matched name + organization together, so not_found rather than risking a namesake. ROUND 2 (arXiv-first): identity further hardened - arXiv API au:"Yongtaek Lim" surfaced a sixth paper, arXiv:2606.09165 'Reliable to Expressive: A Curriculum for Rubric-Following Safety Judges' (Yongtaek Lim1, Hyeji Choi1, Minwoo Kim1, AI Safety Team DATUMO.INC), and three older Kyungwoo Song-lab vision-language papers. The older cluster is confirmed to be the SAME person, not a namesake: the PDF author block of arXiv:2304.10805v3 (EPLKG) prints 'Yongtaek Lim*1 ... 1 DATUMO, Seoul, South Korea' alongside Yonsei/University of Seoul co-authors, and a search snippet independently describes him as 'Researcher at DATUMO since 2024, NLP Researcher at University of Seoul'. Email: I extracted raw text from the PDFs of 2606.09165, 2606.09178v2, 2606.19887, 2602.20170, 2604.18976, 2304.10805, 2203.03897 and 2303.14773 and grepped every page - the only Selectstar/DATUMO address printed anywhere is mwkim@selectstar.ai, and the University of Seoul papers print only changdae.oh@uos.ac.kr, junhyukso@postech.ac.kr and kyungwoo.song@yonsei.ac.kr, never his. The ACL 2026 Findings camera-ready of STAR-Teaming (aclanthology.org/2026.findings-acl.1470.pdf) could not be read - aclanthology.org is blocked by this environment's egress proxy, as are linkedin.com, researchgate.net, scholar.google.com and openreview.net. A Google Scholar profile does exist (scholar.google.com/citations?user=i-BJGx4AAAAJ, 'YongTaek Lim', ~184 citations) but Scholar shows no address and is not a LinkedIn/ResearchGate field. No printed address found, so email stays not_found; no templated selectstar.ai/uos.ac.kr address was constructed.
